new_findings_today.title: Destination TTFB regressed across the board — median jumped from 761 ms (2026-06-03) to 2708 ms today
new_findings_today.detail: Same 10-destination random sampling methodology (deterministic sha256-seeded pick from sitemap-1's 525 slugs). 9 of 10 destinations show TTFB in 2.46-3.08 s on the first cold-cache hit — only srinagar (TTFB 783 ms) stays in yesterday's range. Yesterday only arambol (3642 ms) and vagator (2973 ms) were tail outliers. Today the entire sample is on the bad side of the tail. Most likely the 2026-06-04 deploy that added /cost/{slug} routes (1050 sitemap entries) invalidated the ISR cache for destination/[slug] (shared layout) and the warm-up cron has not caught up. Crawlers will see consistently slow pages until the cache fills.
new_findings_today.evidence: section-B-destinations.csv: alchi 2709, chennai 2994, dhanaulti 2876, mandu 2467, neermahal 2707, palampur 2526, patna 3079, ratnagiri 2910, srinagar 783, sundarbans 2518. min/median/max = 783/2708/3079 ms (yesterday 443/761/3642). Core routes I matrix is healthier (min 134 / median 695 / p90 840 / max 1131) — so the regression is concentrated in the /destination/[slug] template, not the site as a whole.
new_findings_today.recommendation: Trigger a warm-prewarm sweep of the 525 destination slugs (existing scripts/prewarm-next-month-isr.mjs equivalent); then re-probe the same 10 names from cold to confirm the cache filled. Until then SEO crawlers will see Speed Index numbers well above the 2.0 s LH-mobile threshold.

new_findings_today.title: /en/with-kids returns 404 but /en/with-kids/ redirects (308) to that same 404
new_findings_today.detail: Probing /en/with-kids returns HTTP 404; /en/with-kids/ returns HTTP 308 with `Location: /en/with-kids` (i.e. a redirect into a 404). /en/with-kids/mon returns 200, but the obvious sister values /en/with-kids/jan and /en/with-kids/jun also 404. Either the parent index was never wired up (in which case the trailing-slash 308 is misleading and the only valid child is `mon`, which itself is an odd slug) or the parent was removed in a recent deploy and the canonical link target on /en/with-kids/mon now points at a 404. The CLAUDE.md (Pending user-action items) mentions `/with-kids/` as a recent addition — first time it's been included in the daily I matrix.
new_findings_today.recommendation: Either (a) ship an index page at /en/with-kids that lists the available `mon` (and any future) children, or (b) remove the trailing-slash 308 so the page returns a single, deterministic 404 status. The current state — redirect-to-404 — is the worst combination for SEO (crawlers waste budget) and for users (back-button confusion).

real_gap_discovered.title: 45 destinations have no emergency_sos row — the real gap the section-E phone metric never flagged
real_gap_discovered.detail: DB sweep over all 525 destinations: 480 have an emergency_sos row and ALL 480 carry >=3 structured dialable fields (0 with 1-2, 0 with zero). The genuine gap is the 45 with no row at all. ~12 have a confidence_cards.emergency prose fallback (some national numbers); the other ~33 have neither. The universal 112 still works on every page. High-priority because several are very-high-footfall tier-A pilgrimage sites.
real_gap_discovered.recommendation: Backfill emergency_sos for the tier-A subset first via authoritative district-government sources (.gov.in / .nic.in hospital directories + control-room numbers), mirroring the existing sos-research-sweep-2026-05-04 convention. National numbers (100/108/101/1091/1073/112) are universal; only the district-specific control-room + hospital need per-source verification. NEVER fabricate a number. Some (mansarovar-kailash, adi-kailash, mount-kailash) are cross-border/Tibet and may stay honest-scarcity.
real_gap_discovered.resolution: RESOLVED 2026-06-04 — all 45 backfilled (now 525/525 destinations have an emergency_sos row, 0 missing). Done via an adversarially-verified workflow (45 research + 45 independent source-confirmation, Haiku): 35 district control-rooms + 32 hospitals independently confirmed against the cited official source, then district-level numbers propagated to same-district siblings (a district control-room is valid for every town in its district) → 44 verified rows + 1 honest-scarcity (katra/Reasi, national numbers only — no Reasi source confirmable). National numbers (100/108/101/1091/1073/1363) written to all 45. Zero fabrication: any number a verifier could not confirm at its source was left null. verified_by='sos-backfill-2026-06-04'. Artifacts: data/sos/sos-backfill-2026-06-04-{results,rows}.json + .sql; applier scripts/_apply-sos-backfill-2026-06-04.mjs. Live-verified siolim renders the North Goa control-room + Goa Medical College; pages refresh on 24h ISR. 3 clusters used non-.gov sources (borra-caves=press, lahaul-spiti=pragya.net NGO, manimahesh/chamba=chambaonline) — verifier-confirmed + plausible but lower-confidence; worth a future .gov re-check.
